description: This is a Java class named HelloController that defines several REST API endpoints using Spring Boot annotations. It includes endpoints for a welcome message, API documentation redirection, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic chat backend endpoints such as welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to root '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a simple health check response indicating the application is running.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns information about the running application.
